targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
  sum(sendrate${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(sendrate${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw})*8 AS "UP", sum(receiverate${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(receiverate${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw})*8 AS "DOWN",
  sum(downstreammax${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(downstreammax${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw}) AS "DOWN Max", sum(downstream_dsl_sync_max${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(downstream_dsl_sync_max${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw})*1000 AS "DOWN DSL Sync",
  sum(downstreamphysicalmax${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(downstreamphysicalmax${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw}) AS "DOWN Physical Max", sum(upstreammax${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(upstreammax${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw}) AS "UP netto Max",
  sum(upstream_dsl_sync_max${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(upstream_dsl_sync_max${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw})*1000 AS "UP DSL Sync", sum(upstreamphysicalmax${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(upstreamphysicalmax${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw}) AS "UP Physical Max"
FROM ${metric_source:raw}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND (sendrate${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL
       OR receiverate${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval ALIGN TO CALENDAR

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  sum(crc_errors_delta) AS "CRC Errors",
  sum(errored_seconds_delta) AS "Errored Seconds",
  sum(severely_errored_seconds_delta) AS "Severely Errored Seconds"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp,
    CASE WHEN previous_crc_errors IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN crc_errors${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_crc_errors THEN crc_errors${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_crc_errors
      ELSE 0 END AS crc_errors_delta,
    CASE WHEN previous_errored_seconds IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_errored_seconds THEN errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_errored_seconds
      ELSE 0 END AS errored_seconds_delta,
    CASE WHEN previous_severely_errored_seconds IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN severely_errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_severely_errored_seconds THEN severely_errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_severely_errored_seconds
      ELSE 0 END AS severely_errored_seconds_delta
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, box, crc_errors${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}, errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}, severely_errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}, lag(crc_errors${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_crc_errors, lag(errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_errored_seconds, lag(severely_errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_severely_errored_seconds
    FROM ${metric_source:raw}
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
      AND (crc_errors${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL OR errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL OR severely_errored_seconds${metric_source_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL)
  )
)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval ALIGN TO CALENDAR

SELECT timestamp AS time, log_entry AS line, log_type
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND log_entry IS NOT NULL

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, linkuptime AS "Link Uptime (s)"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'

ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT sum(receiverate) * 8 AS "receiverate"
FROM (
  SELECT box, receiverate
  FROM ${measurement}
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -5, now())
    AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
    AND receiverate IS NOT NULL
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY box
)

SELECT sum(sendrate) * 8 AS "sendrate"
FROM (
  SELECT box, sendrate
  FROM ${measurement}
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -5, now())
    AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
    AND sendrate IS NOT NULL
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY box
)

SELECT timestamp AS time, cpu_temp AS "CPU Temp (°C)"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND cpu_temp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "Upload Last 24h"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp,
    CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN totalbytessent${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_value THEN totalbytessent${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_value
      ELSE 0
    END AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, totalbytessent${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw}, lag(totalbytessent${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_value
    FROM ${metric_source_1d:raw}
    WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
      AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
      AND totalbytessent${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL
  )
)

SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "Download Last 24h"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp,
    CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN totalbytesreceived${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_value THEN totalbytesreceived${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_value
      ELSE 0
    END AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, totalbytesreceived${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw}, lag(totalbytesreceived${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_value
    FROM ${metric_source_1d:raw}
    WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
      AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
      AND totalbytesreceived${metric_source_1d_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL
  )
)

SELECT timestamp AS time, num_active_host AS "Active Hosts"

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  sum(totalbytessent_delta) AS "Upload",
  sum(totalbytesreceived_delta) AS "Download"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp,
    CASE WHEN previous_totalbytessent IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN totalbytessent${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_totalbytessent THEN totalbytessent${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_totalbytessent
      ELSE 0 END AS totalbytessent_delta,
    CASE WHEN previous_totalbytesreceived IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN totalbytesreceived${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} >= previous_totalbytesreceived THEN totalbytesreceived${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} - previous_totalbytesreceived
      ELSE 0 END AS totalbytesreceived_delta
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, box, totalbytessent${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw}, totalbytesreceived${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw}, lag(totalbytessent${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_totalbytessent, lag(totalbytesreceived${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw}) OVER (PARTITION BY box ORDER BY timestamp) AS previous_totalbytesreceived
    FROM ${metric_source_7d:raw}
    WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -7, now())
      AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
      AND (totalbytessent${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL OR totalbytesreceived${metric_source_7d_counter_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL)
  )
)
SAMPLE BY 1d ALIGN TO CALENDAR

SELECT timestamp AS time,

targets.rawSql:
SELECT last_not_null(external_ip) AS "IPv4", last_not_null(external_ipv6) AS "IPv6",
  last_not_null(ipv6_prefix) AS "IPv6 Prefix", last_not_null(ipv6_prefix_length) AS "IPv6 Prefix Length",
  last_not_null(model) AS "Model", last_not_null(serialnumber) AS "Serial",
  last_not_null(softwareversion) AS "SW Version", last_not_null(last_auth_error) AS "Last Auth Error",
  last_not_null(CASE WHEN myfritz_host_name = '' THEN NULL ELSE myfritz_host_name END) AS "MyFritz Hostname"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'

SELECT last_not_null(physicallinktype) AS "Link Type", last_not_null(dsl_line_length) AS "Approx. DSL Length (m)",
  last_not_null(dsl_dslam_vendor) AS "DSL DSLAM Vendor", last_not_null(dsl_dslam_sw_version) AS "DSL Model Version",
  last_not_null(dsl_line_mode) AS "DSL Line Mode", last_not_null(cable_cmts_vendor) AS "Cable Vendor",
  last_not_null(cable_line_mode) AS "Cable Line Mode", last_not_null(cable_modem_version) AS "Cable Modem Version",
  last_not_null(cable_num_ds_channels) AS "Cable Downstream Channels", last_not_null(cable_num_us_channels) AS "Cable Upstream Channels",
  last_not_null(connection_status) AS "IP Connection Status", last_not_null(last_connection_error) AS "Last Connection Error",
  last_not_null(remote_pop) AS "Remote Pop", last_not_null(physical_connection_status) AS "Link Connection Status"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  sum(vpn_user_num_active${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw}) / ${metric_source_gauge_count_aggregate:raw}(vpn_user_num_active${metric_source_gauge_count_suffix:raw}) AS "vpn_user_num_active"
FROM ${metric_source:raw}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND (vpn_user_num_active${metric_source_gauge_sum_suffix:raw} IS NOT NULL)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval ALIGN TO CALENDAR

SELECT last_not_null(vpn_type) AS "VPN Type", last_not_null(vpn_user_num_active) AS "VPN User Active"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND (vpn_type IS NOT NULL OR vpn_user_num_active IS NOT NULL)

SELECT last_not_null(ddns_domain) AS "Domain",
  last_not_null(CASE WHEN ddns_provider_name IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ddns_enabled THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END) AS "Enabled",
  last_not_null(ddns_mode) AS "Mode", last_not_null(ddns_provider_name) AS "Provider",
  last_not_null(ddns_status_ipv4) AS "Status IPv4", last_not_null(ddns_status_ipv6) AS "Status IPv6"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND (ddns_domain IS NOT NULL OR ddns_mode IS NOT NULL
       OR ddns_provider_name IS NOT NULL OR ddns_status_ipv4 IS NOT NULL OR ddns_status_ipv6 IS NOT NULL)

SELECT name AS "Name", vpn_type AS "Type",
  last_not_null(CASE WHEN vpn_user_active THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END) AS "Active", last_not_null(CASE WHEN vpn_user_connected THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END) AS "Connected",
  last_not_null(vpn_user_virtual_address) AS "Virtual Address", last_not_null(vpn_user_remote_address) AS "Remote Address"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('d', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND name IS NOT NULL
  AND vpn_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY name, vpn_type
ORDER BY name

SELECT timestamp AS time, active_hosts_name AS "Name",
  active_hosts_mac AS "MAC", active_hosts_ipv4 AS "IPv4",
  active_hosts_type AS "Type", active_hosts_parent AS "Parent",
  active_hosts_port AS "Port", active_hosts_additional_text AS "Info",
  active_hosts_ipv4_last_used AS "Last seen"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('h', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND active_hosts_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT timestamp AS time, passive_hosts_name AS "Name",
  passive_hosts_mac AS "MAC", passive_hosts_ipv4 AS "IPv4",
  passive_hosts_port AS "Port"
FROM ${measurement}
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('h', -1, now())
  AND box ~ '^${boxtag:regex}$'
  AND passive_hosts_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT CASE
  WHEN enabled = true AND schema_version = 1
    AND ((profile = 'low' AND raw_days > 0 AND raw_days <= 30 AND rollup_interval = '1m' AND rollup_view = '${measurement}_rollup_1m_v1') OR (profile = 'medium' AND raw_days > 0 AND raw_days <= 7 AND rollup_interval = '1m' AND rollup_view = '${measurement}_rollup_1m_v1') OR (profile = 'high' AND raw_days > 0 AND raw_days <= 1 AND rollup_interval = '5m' AND rollup_view = '${measurement}_rollup_5m_v1')) THEN profile
  ELSE 'disabled' END
FROM "_fritzfluxdb_downsampling"
WHERE measurement = '${measurement}'
LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY measurement

list.definition:
SELECT source
FROM (
  SELECT table_name AS source, 0 AS priority
  FROM tables()
  WHERE (('${downsampling_profile:raw}' = 'low' AND $__fromTime < dateadd('d', -${downsampling_raw_days:raw}, now()) AND table_name = '${measurement}_rollup_1m_v1')
      OR ('${downsampling_profile:raw}' = 'medium' AND $__fromTime < dateadd('d', -${downsampling_raw_days:raw}, now()) AND table_name = '${measurement}_rollup_1m_v1')
      OR ('${downsampling_profile:raw}' = 'high' AND $__fromTime < dateadd('d', -${downsampling_raw_days:raw}, now()) AND table_name = '${measurement}_rollup_5m_v1'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT table_name AS source, 1 AS priority
  FROM tables()
  WHERE table_name = '${measurement}'
)
ORDER BY priority
LIMIT 1
